revisions.script:
[scene]INT. ARCHIVE VAULT - NIGHT
[action]Maya locks a red folder inside the safe.
[scene]INT. ARCHIVE VAULT - LATER
[action]The safe stands open and the red folder is gone. Scratches ring the keyhole and a bent pick lies on the floor.
[scene]INT. INTERVIEW ROOM - DAY
[character]JON
[dialogue]I have never been inside the archive.
[action]Jon avoids the camera and hides mud-stained shoes beneath his chair.
[scene]EXT. RIVER WAREHOUSE - DAY
[action]Tessa Gray, reported missing yesterday, steps from a hidden observation room.
[character]TESSA
[dialogue]The disappearance was staged to expose the leak.
[scene]INT. SECURITY DESK - DAY
[action]Kira approaches Security Officer Daniels for the first time.
[character]KIRA
[dialogue]Someone opened the vault. Check the cameras.
